task_title: Falsify LOS allocation-churn hypothesis; add bench + barrier-share diagnostic

plan_review.notes: Adversarial audit of the NEGATIVE result: asked specifically whether the harness could be biased against the candidate (the failure mode that would make a no-ship verdict wrong). Verdict APPROVE-WITH-CONCERNS; no blocking issue changes the ship-nothing-to-src decision. 5 concerns, all resolved: (1) reported range 0.91x-1.05x contradicted a recorded 1.111x and the worst-round>1 pass criterion was stricter than the skill recipe - range corrected to 0.897x-1.111x and the bench pass marker now keys on median + >=80pct rounds won; (2) candidate-disadvantaging confounds (extra dispatch in SCALAR-MAP, subclass transitive polymorphism, symmetric barrier delegation) - all three now enumerated in the bench header and a dedicated handoff section, conclusion restated as 'no shipping-grade production win' rather than clean mechanistic falsification; (3) FACTUAL ERROR found - the barrier-share lower-bound argument assumed live barriers block segments, but the Floor-1 fixture registry is empty; independently re-verified (0 handles / 0 blocked tiles / 0 ring shapes, identical sink counts 54180 vs 54180 and 14859 vs 14859) and the diagnostic now prints registry sizes and sink counts and states what it actually measures; (4) the 2.24pct Amdahl floor came from a synthetic segment mix not a production-weighted one - now explicitly caveated in the handoff with the instrumentation work required before quoting it; (5) escape-analysis causal claim overstated - now labelled an explanation, not a demonstration.

rounds.notes: Exhaustive review of the committed bench + handoff. 4 issues, all High/Medium, all fixed: (1) RecordingScalarMap.pendingTileX could silently desync across segments on an exception or a double worldToTileX - now guarded by an explicit throw plus a reset() called per segment; (2) both oracle subclasses inlined a copy of FloorMap.isPassableAt to avoid double-counting the internal tile conversion, which would silently drift if the real implementation changed - replaced with a probeDepth counter plus super.isPassableAt() in try/finally, so the oracle is pinned to the shipped implementation; (3) checkShippedCopiesMatchReal compared only booleans and only one of the two local copies - now compares the ordered probe trace for both copies, and was moved to run AFTER the timing panels because it needs a recording receiver and would otherwise make two of the three timed functions polymorphic; (4) runBarrierShareDiagnostic mutated world.floorMap without try/finally, so a throw in attachBarriersToFloorMap would leak the clone - now restored in finally. Reviewer independently verified the paired-ratio rotation math, confirmed the two shipped twin copies are byte-identical, confirmed the Amdahl arithmetic (0.553pct and 1.12pct) and the ratio-to-share derivations, and ran tsc --noEmit and eslint clean.
